69788d4e963f08d9140bce19.description: So, you ready to prove your professional chops? I'm not going to go too hard on you, don't sweat it. For starters, just step onto the Arena. Yeah, that's all, no extra tasks. Just soak in the atmosphere!
69788d4e963f08d9140bce19.success: Yeah, yeah, I saw you in action. You're not exactly grabbing the stars yet, but at least there's something to work with.

697878057aa1273126030fb0.description: You really thought I'd just take you on after a few completed jobs? No, kid, I take this seriously, and that means you've still got some running to do. Help me out in the Arena, and you'll move up fast. Refuse, and… well, you get the idea. It's all in your hands.
697878057aa1273126030fb0.success: At first, I thought you'd quit. Figured you were the type who wants to get everything as fast as possible. But you pleasantly surprised me.

69789660b2187365e70bb94a.description: Alright, you made yourself noticed again. I won't lie, it was impressive. You even got the attention of some big players. Not without a little help from me, of course: you should've heard how I was hyping you up! Now, if you want to earn more cash, you've got to hold your spot at the top. Show that you're ready to tear your opponents apart with your bare hands!
69789660b2187365e70bb94a.success: Ha! You put on an amazing show! But those interested parties bailed. Who knows why. Maybe it was too bloody for their delicate eyes. Oh well, they're not the last. For now, here, this one's reserved just for you.

6978907718bd6d7cbd0e8b8e.description: Ready to keep going? Of course it's not over, what else did you expect? We're not messing around here, I take this seriously. So, you've smelled gunpowder, now you need to prove to me that you can kill. A lot. And, preferably, make it look good. So, you ready? Alright, I'll be keeping an eye on you in the Arena.
6978907718bd6d7cbd0e8b8e.success: You did well, took them down like puppies! I think you've got potential.

697895277d31587eab080266.description: So, you thought that was it, that you'd reached the top? Think again. Yeah, people are betting on you, but you've got to make sure they don't forget about you. Otherwise they'll wave goodbye and start tossing money at someone else. And we don't want that. I've got a solution for you. People remember victories best — especially a streak of them. Set up a streak like that for yourself, and you can relax after.
697895277d31587eab080266.success: All done? Well, I hardly had any doubts. Here, take this, a nice little bonus for you.

6a45208043b8d7604d00b8d5.description: In our line of work, we can't afford to rest or slow down. Evil won't be defeated that way. So here's my next task for you. I've been told that something suspicious is happening at the Reserve base, around the loading area. Head there and deal with whatever filth has gathered there. And don't forget to fire the signal flare first, so I know you've begun your work. I'll take care of anyone who tries to run.
6a45208043b8d7604d00b8d5.success: You and I make a fine team.

6a5cd2178fd7c2b201032f3f.description: Good day, mercenary. You arrived just in time. Some of my partners would like us to test the weapons before purchasing them. They require a demonstration. Take 7.62x51 assault rifles and designated marksman rifles and head to Reserve. There has been some suspicious activity reported there recently... Let us combine business with pleasure.
6a5cd2178fd7c2b201032f3f.success: I have already been informed of how you performed. The order from my partners has been confirmed.

6a959d33b9b22567ed0d0a4e.description: Come on in, brother! I've got a new little business venture here, and I'm looking for someone who can help me out. I was recently contacted by someone from across the border. Turns out there's a demand over there for stuff taken out of Tarkov. I don't really get who'd be into that, but money's money. Especially when it comes to luxury goods with a bit of history from the city. Yeah, that's exactly how the guy put it. I've got the manpower and plenty of motivation to make some serious cash. But most importantly, I've got experience faking luxury goods. I'm thinking of setting up a workshop to put together some Louise Pitton accessories. Go collect some useful stuff around Tarkov from this list, and I'll make it worth your while.
6a959d33b9b22567ed0d0a4e.success: You helped me out big time, bro! There's already a queue back home for my goods with a "history". Here, take this, for your help.

6a4532e48e82d8ffea0c3eae.description: Hello-hello. I've got a new job for you. There's been a lot of talk lately about those so-called laboratories. I don't like all this commotion, especially all the pillagers dragging whatever they can get their hands on out of those places. Head down there and thin their ranks. Make an example of them so others think twice before following in their footsteps. Do it quickly, or they won't get the message.
6a4532e48e82d8ffea0c3eae.success: I've already heard rumors of what you did. Keep it up.

6834287b7559f4e6d50bc0fa.description: Well, you fucked up with the evidence in a very embarrassing way, but sure, I'll keep my word. I'll get you your fucking container. But now I'm gonna ask you for something else, since things got so ugly.
6834287b7559f4e6d50bc0fa.success: All right, you've earned your reward. But you better know I'm not gonna take any more of your bullshit. You start digging again, you'll end up like that old champion.

6942b44f891369fc790e385a.description: Hello. One of your people stopped by recently and tried to convince me that the most important part of a fighter's gear is armor, and that situational awareness doesn't matter nearly as much. Frankly, I don't share that view. Sure, you can't see or hear absolutely everything. But armor will never give you complete protection either, especially if you walk into an ambush. Personally, I'd take a good headset over heavy, reinforced armor any day. Fortunately, I don't have to make that choice myself. So what would you choose? You've got enough experience to test this properly in the field. Better yet, let's try this: you gather some real statistics using two different loadouts, and in return I'll arrange a supply of some unique items from Peacekeeper. He owes me a favor, you see. Try neutralizing PMC operatives while wearing a headset but no armor. Then do the opposite, say... using a tank crew helmet. That should put you at a serious information disadvantage.
6942b44f891369fc790e385a.success: So, how did it go? You're saying you need both gear and good hearing? Yes, that's exactly what I expected. Still, the research was useful, so you've earned your reward. Those headsets are usually custom-made, but Peacekeeper should be able to supply models that fit you properly.

68ee1c18b4e5bc9a68018cd7.description: Hey there, soldier! Got a job for you that I wouldn't trust to just anyone. Special order, you could say. I need an ice axe. Wipe that look off your face! And keep your mouth shut about this job, or we'll both catch hell. So don't go checking the Flea Market or asking the other traders. You need to find one yourself, quietly. No unnecessary witnesses. Got it? Word is Shturman was seen carrying the right kind of ice axe. The Cultists might've stashed one away in their hideouts, too... But that's unconfirmed. Either way, that's your problem now, not mine! Get this done, and I'll arrange access to a very special weapon, just for you. Ever since the Contract Wars, these things have become almost impossible to get. I'm giving you a one-of-a-kind opportunity here. Don't waste it.
68ee1c18b4e5bc9a68018cd7.success: Good work. And not a word about this to anyone, understood? Better keep your head down for a while, too. If anyone gets too curious, keep them at arm's length. My little gift should help with that.

69c27158e350f01390049e77.description: You did pretty well helping with the Rogues, and the smugglers actually came to me themselves. One of their commanders is being held by those bastards over at the water treatment plant, and the guys want to get their own man back. But for that, they need a reliable route from Priozersk to the Rogue base. If you help with that, maybe we can talk about your request too. You'll need to go along the path from the nature reserve to the lighthouse and mark the start and end of the route.
69c27158e350f01390049e77.success: Let's hope this smuggler operation goes smoothly.

69c26c07683c9831020018c7.description: I already told you everything in the car. But if you really wanna get the smugglers to put in a more comfortable transport option to Icebreaker, you'll need to help them out with their fight against the Rogues first. Looks like things between them are pretty serious, and honestly I have no idea where it's going worst. So you can take initiative anywhere you want, just make sure there are fewer Rogue fighters left. Otherwise the smugglers won't even listen to you, they've got bigger problems right now.
69c26c07683c9831020018c7.success: Didn't think you'd do it this well. Good work, man.

68db9c7557bc51a8c804c14b.description: Hello. I used to believe that staying inside clear boundaries and doing the job by the book was the highest form of professionalism. When you can pick the right tool for any task and never step out of the top league. Working only with the best equipment. But Tarkov showed me that being just a professional isn’t enough. Here I learned that true mastery is forged under harsh conditions with limited resources, when the outcome can’t be predicted. You start relying more on your own experience and intuition, and if you’re good enough — you rise to the very top. Since the Contract Wars, I’ve held on to a small reserve of special weapons. But like in my line of work, they’re only tools. An ordinary professional doesn’t have the skills to unlock the full potential of such a piece. It takes a true master. And I’m starting to think you might be able to handle such a temperamental weapon. If you can prove that you can solve problems no matter what tools you’re given — I’ll open access to this special section of my arsenal.
68db9c7557bc51a8c804c14b.success: Managed it? Honestly, I wasn’t sure we’d ever come back to this conversation. But I’ll keep my word. Back during the Contract Wars, everyone feared this weapon. BEAR operatives who carried it were unbeatable. And for USECs, getting their hands on one was considered an incredible stroke of luck. Not because the weapon makes you immortal. But because its owner is a true master — someone nobody wants to face.

69ce204c8702b378f9091e4b.description: Hello, mercenary. In field conditions it is extremely important to anticipate any potential hazards in advance. Once a patient is already on the operating table, you can only work with whatever is available at hand. That is why I would like you to bring me high-dose potassium iodide tablets. Yes, these are used in cases of severe radiation exposure. And no, we have not recorded any leaks recently. I must ask you not to spread information about this order. You do not realize how severely panic among the population can complicate the work of my department. I am simply preparing for any incidents that may occur in the future. The issue is that in Tarkov itself we have never found this dosage. Such preparations are typically stored at nuclear facilities, as they are only relevant there. I hope your search proves more successful than that of my staff.
69ce204c8702b378f9091e4b.success: Where did you manage to obtain so many? I was not even expecting five packs… The Icebreaker? Such a find could be extremely important for supporting our work. I need to check something in the department, and then I will return to you with a new task. We cannot afford to miss an opportunity of this value.

69ce1de03e15cd80bd06f6c9.description: Heya there, warrior! Since you already know about my little helicopter secret, I've got a job for you. If you want my bird to keep picking you up from the ship, it needs regular maintenance. Remember that special lubricant you brought me? You won't find that stuff in Tarkov, but there should still be some supplies left on the Icebreaker. Go take a look, check the helipad and storage areas. Anything you find in cans, bring it back to me. You've got your own interest in this too, so you won't be doing it for nothing. And if you manage to pull together a decent stock, I'll even pay extra.
69ce1de03e15cd80bd06f6c9.success: Alright, you handled that job well. I'll give you that. Maybe things between us will keep going smooth, just don't forget your reputation and don't even think about screwing me over. You're dismissed for now, soldier.

69ce21e990144e437802b1e0.description: Howdy, ahper! I heard there's some serious commotion going on at some ship in the bay. Apparently some unknown group is operating there, definitely not one of your guys. You see where I'm going with this? If it's neither BEAR nor USEC, then their gear has to be something special. And special goods are the best goods, brother! If you can get to that ship and bring me back any captured armor or rigs, they'll fly off the shelves. And you'll get your cut too, you know me!
69ce21e990144e437802b1e0.success: Lemme take a look… With a bit of work, this could even pass as brand new! My guys have restored gear in worse condition than this. I never doubted you, brother, your share is already here. Come pick it up whenever it suits you, yeah?

69ce1cfb298a6529b30d712b.description: Sit down kid, got something to talk about. Partisan spotted helicopters over the bay, no markings on them. They were heading straight for some ship out there, definitely not toward the city. Those were combat birds, not belonging to the UNTAR troops or any PMC, that's for certain. He said he's only seen something like that once before, and that wasn't even in Tarkov. If this is some kind of special unit, nothing good will come from it. Most likely they're pulling in veterans from elite forces, could be SAS, Mossad, or God knows who else these days. I asked Mechanic if he knows anything about them. He's been listening in on that frequency range, managed to catch the callsign of their leader, though barely. "Wedge”... Listen, we can't let people like that dig in, not on the ship, and definitely not in the city. I'm counting on you here. Best meet fire with fire, like they say.
69ce1cfb298a6529b30d712b.success: Good thing I trusted my instincts. We need to keep Tarkov safe from fighters like this. If they get a foothold, they'll take control of the whole city, and nobody will be able to stop them after that. If you see those black-clad soldiers again, don't let them slip away. Our survival might depend on it.

69c2a2d004de49c8f0055a3d.description: I went over to the guys, we had a real good talk... When you're ready, just come see me and I'll tell you everything, uh... In person!
69c2a2d004de49c8f0055a3d.success: The smugglers are ready to help you, but not for free. So if you're ready to pay, we can get you to Icebreaker straight from your little basement. Just give me a heads-up in advance, alright?

69c277f3ea6da9c23e07f8d2.description: Alright, well the smugglers managed to get their commander out, though not without losses. I'm heading over to talk things through and ask about you as well. But you get it, right now they need to both celebrate the win and properly remember the ones they lost. So I can't show up empty-handed. You gonna help set the table?
69c277f3ea6da9c23e07f8d2.success: That's a decent haul of grub you brought. With stuff like this, the conversation will go a lot easier. By the next time we meet, I should have something for you about your request.

6a5ccda873f06065630d61b0.description: How do you feel about 12-gauge shotguns? And what about scavengers? Good. Let us combine the two for maximum efficiency. Clear the downtown using these weapons. Why? Because we intend to send a message to those who are meant to receive it. I cannot tell you anything more than that.
6a5ccda873f06065630d61b0.success: Great job! The message has been sent and received.

6a5c1578f2689567c30eb0f3.description: Hello, my friend! Do you enjoy hiking? I do not, which is why I need your help. In the northwestern part of the Priozersk forest, scavengers are preventing my men from delivering humanitarian supplies. The area must be cleared. Got it?
6a5c1578f2689567c30eb0f3.success: You did it! Great! Here is your reward.

6a5424ae135497b9df0c68be.description: Good afternoon, young man. Last fall, Tarkov experienced a severe influenza outbreak. I caught it twice myself. This year, however, I managed to arrange for an influenza vaccine to be delivered through the UN peacekeepers' supply channels... Though that isn't why I asked you here. I'm planning to organize a vaccination campaign this fall, but before that, I need to vaccinate myself and everyone working at my clinic. Unfortunately, sterile syringes are in short supply. Could you obtain five for me? Please make sure their packaging remains intact!
6a5424ae135497b9df0c68be.success: Were you able to find them? Excellent, I'll begin administering the vaccines tomorrow.

6a7ae35b2dbf91eb050af95a.description: Hello. I ask that you not discuss this assignment with anyone. You may also keep any questions you have to yourself. Recently, one of my shipments of injectors was intercepted by the Rogues. It seems that after the battle at the treatment plant, they have started carrying out bolder and more aggressive raids in search of equipment and medical supplies. I would be more than happy to help the wounded, but these people are trying to obtain what they need behind my back! I'm sorry... In any case, I cannot allow them to conduct business this way, and I have no choice but to respond. This needs to be handled in such a way that they never try to take my goods without my knowledge again. They keep the medications taken from my group in their chalets. Replace some of them with experimental drugs produced by Sanitar.
6a7ae35b2dbf91eb050af95a.success: I hope you haven't told anyone about our business. I think you understand how dangerous it is to show weakness in a place like Tarkov has become. After all, I pay you for your professionalism and impartiality in your work. Let's continue to uphold those standards.

6a7af2e48fddc3979d0510b8.description: Good to see you, brother! I've got a job, and it's one only a master like you can handle. Some Scavs recently intercepted a shipment of plate carriers I had near the lighthouse. Nothing too fancy in there, but those fuckers need to pay for stealing my goods! Only, we're gonna do this one a little differently. I want to see how plate carriers in this price range hold up against different calibers, and now we've got a bunch of idiots walking around wearing them! So we might as well make this test as close to real combat as possible. Take two different caliber rifles on the job and do your part. Just don't shoot 'em in the head, okay? I'm interested in how well the armor holds up! Don't bring the carriers back to me. Once you're done, I'll send my guys to collect the "samples".
6a7af2e48fddc3979d0510b8.success: So, you tired from lugging two guns around? But most importantly, you did the job right, as always! I'll send my guys after the armor now. You get some rest. Maybe these tests will even give us some ideas for improving the gear...

6a7aef2360157cb5e3029a5f.description: Hey. Got a little number for ya. One of Knight's lads got in touch with me recently, so I was already gearing up for a new supply line... Keeping the Rogues stocked with gear's only gonna do me good, specially if them smugglers are starting to get a bit too fucking big for their boots! But after the first order of basic supplies and ammo, the whole thing went quiet. Reckon the Rogues think they're all sorted now and have properly dug in at the chalets. So I'm thinking, why not give 'em a little nudge to start buying again, eh? Just make bloody sure none of 'em cottons on that I'm behind it, got me? Heard some important package turned up for them recently. That's what we're after. We need to make it look like Prapor's lot came calling, and we need to put on a proper show. So grab something unmistakably Russian and carry out a textbook raid on the chalets, then relieve 'em of their little box! Bring the box to me, mind. Never know when something like that might come in handy.
6a7aef2360157cb5e3029a5f.success: Fucking beautiful! So, you didn't look inside the box, did ya? Good lad, that's exactly what I wanted! Now hand it over. I'll have a look myself.

6a7b0df31ea00c9a980e2742.description: How's your physical shape, ahper? I've got one deal that's still hanging over my head, and I could really use some help. But I'll tell you right now, you can throw your back out in no time doing this! So, I've made contact with the smugglers. Wouldn't exactly call it a partnership, but they've got a decent job for me. We need to deliver some armor plates to their boys. Everything's already packed up and waiting at the drop-off points, so all that's left is getting it to the recipients. You in? Both cases with the armor plates are in Priozersk right now. One's in the bunker, and the other's at the abandoned USEC checkpoint. One case needs to be hauled to the guardhouse at the military base. You want the one next to the trail leading to Woods. The second case is supposed to go in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train station near the water treatment plant. Once you've left both cases at the right spots, let the armored train engineer know.
6a7b0df31ea00c9a980e2742.success: After a job like that, you oughta spend at least a couple days lying down, brother! You really bailed me out. I didn't have anyone else who could handle a job that damn monumental. I've got a special reward ready for you. Here, take it. It'll give you an excuse to hang around the hideout and put those plates in the case properly.

61e6e60c5ca3b3783662be27.description: You know, doing errands all day is still not enough to improve your poor situation. I think there is and easier way. Bribe the right people and they'll sing praises about how amazing you are. For example, you can compensate the friends of those you killed due to your brain disorder. Something like a wergild for murder in the Middle Ages.
61e6e60c5ca3b3783662be27.success: Outstanding. Part of the compensation will go where it needs to go, and the other part will stay with me. Let's say it's for maintaining our cooperation.

69ce213a298a6529b30d7134.description: This icebreaker you've found is a real discovery! If it is located that far out, there could still be medical equipment on board that survived the blast in the city center… We will not get a second opportunity like this. In conditions of isolation and the inability to provide full hospital care, we usually rely on specialized biochemical analyzers. They allow us to perform a wide range of tests quickly and with the necessary accuracy. However, most of the reserve units in Tarkov were taken by emergency services during the evacuation. But on the icebreaker there could still be analyzers in working condition. Especially if it is connected to TerraGroup. Search for them for me, preferably several. The ship likely had its own medical section where they could have been installed.
69ce213a298a6529b30d7134.success: You found the Aceso? That is probably the best news of the day. Given the shortages in Tarkov, they will be a very valuable asset… But of course, I will only consider parting with them in cases of extreme necessity. For now, they will go straight into operation and greatly ease the workload of my staff and patients.

69ce1f84ebbdbf36a200627c.description: Greetings. I have an urgent assignment for you. You are not yet aware of the situation, so I will need to provide some context. However, everything I am about to disclose is top secret, understood? There is a secured facility within the blockade perimeter that is of interest to my contacts in the nuclear energy sector. The issue is that it is an icebreaker ship, currently stranded in the bay. To access it, you will need to acquire suitable transport, and it is preferable to do so quietly. No one must know that the vessel is present in Tarkov's waters at all! Once you secure transport, you are to retrieve operational documentation from the ship. Search the engineering sections, there should be a logbook for the nuclear power unit control system. Do not, under any circumstances, disclose this task to anyone.
69ce1f84ebbdbf36a200627c.success: You have the logbook? I trust you avoided drawing attention on your way back. I will arrange your reward through my associates. One more thing: I strongly advise against returning to the Icebreaker. According to my sources, it has already come under the control of some special unit. You would not survive an engagement with them.

69e5583240c3e6c8ba0edbd5.description: It looks like you will have to return to the Icebreaker after all. The data from the nuclear power plant logbook was not sufficient. Our partners need real-time readings from the power unit, so I've purchased a special device from Mechanic for remote connection to the central control station. Before you install it, however, you must ensure that all equipment in the technical areas is functioning properly. Take tools with you and restore the circuit breakers that have been taken offline, then install this device in the control room. I have been informed that the damaged breakers are likely located in three areas. One is directly on the way to the engine room, near the locker rooms with coats. The second is directly beneath that section. The third is somewhere in the corridors running along the engine compartment. Once you have restored all breakers, return to the central control station. Install the device there and report back.
69e5583240c3e6c8ba0edbd5.success: It seems Mechanic’s device is functioning properly. I hope you managed to avoid contact with the special unit I warned you about. My recommendation remains the same: if you want to survive, it would be best not to return to that site.

657315ddab5a49b71f098853.description: Greetings, young man. I need you to complete a quick assignment for me. Nothing too extraordinary yet, we have only just begun working together. There are still civilians in the city, and they're trying to get out. The best place to organize an evacuation would be the Emercom checkpoint: it should have both the vehicles and the necessary equipment. At least, I hope so. I haven't been to that part of the city very often, so I don't know exactly where the checkpoint is located. Find it for me. Once you do, I'll send my people to inspect the area. And one more thing. I'm in need of supplies for my medical duty. I can't exactly import them to Tarkov anymore, so we have to look for what we can find. It doesn't matter what you bring: consumables, medicine, stimulants. Anything useful will do. I'll be waiting.

657315df034d76585f032e01.description: Greetings! I hear you're looking for a little extra cash. That's perfect, because I have a job for you... I know that the city center is where AGSs and KORDs were deployed during the hottest fights. Find me one of each and report back. Also, sweep the area around them, make sure no one gets to the firing positions before my guys do. I think five bodies will be enough. Scavs, PMCs, whatever. Less trespassers, less chance of an ambush, you know?

657315e270bb0b8dba00cc48.description: Looking for a job, you say? I have a little thing to take care of... I got a buddy who drives people around in his SUV from the city center, where that blue boom happened. For cash, obviously! You have to whisper something in his ear, but do it during your trip, so that no scum can overhear you. I won't trust you with anything very secret, don't even dream of it, but I don't want any rumors to spread. Job's easy enough, I'll even give you the money for the ride. You up for it?

657315e4a6af4ab4b50f3459.description: Hello, mercenary. I've got a lot of work, so I'll be brief. TerraGroup sent a USEC task force after one of their employees. He was accused of leaking information and they wanted him removed. I don't know if they succeeded or not, which is why you need to investigate this. Check the TerraGroup complex in the city center, look for traces of both the squad and the employee. I used to work with him, so I want to know what happened in the end. He almost always carried a drive with his important data on it, so if you find it, bring it to me.

59c9392986f7742f6923add2.description: Good afternoon, young man. Tarkov has endured a humanitarian crisis for far too many years. I'm sure you understand that civilians need places where they can shelter from both Scavs and mercenaries. I've done everything I can to help them, but lately that has become increasingly difficult. Could you obtain the keys to several locations I have identified? My people will be able to establish safe havens there for those in need.

5a68663e86f774501078f78a.description: Thanks for your assistance with the vans. We were just in time, even those Scavs didn't have time to pull them apart. While researching the aftermath of the tunnel collapse, we’ve run across a TerraGroup executive's Geländewagen. It appears that part of the company’s top managers perished there while trying to evacuate. I’m aware that medical research was one of the top priorities for the company, and I'm almost sure that they had no time to evacuate its data and materials in time. Whatever they were doing, I think it can turn out to be very valuable, both for us and for medical science in general. It can earn us a ticket from Tarkov, even more than one. I’ve regularly met up with certain TerraGroup employees to discuss health care issues, so I'm pretty familiar with some of their works. One of my acquaintances, who, by the way, directly reported to that deceased Geländewagen management, used to live in the health resort building. Let me look it up... here it is, room 306. Search it for anything that could possibly be left behind.

639135d89444fb141f4e6eea.description: Good afternoon, mercenary. You're just in time, I have an errand for you. I need to determine how many people have gone missing in the city. To do this, I need a list of all the residents of the city and subtract the already evacuated, the dead, and those who found shelter in the hospital. Your task is to find that list of residents. Bring me the journal from Primorsky District's Housing Department.

669fa39ee749756c920d02c8.description: Hello, young man. I've received information that one of the tank containers at the Polikhim chemical plant has been damaged. Judging by the description of the liquid inside, it doesn't look like any of the emulsions declared in the official documents. I think the substance in the tank could be hazardous, so I'm asking you to get me a sample as soon as possible. This is the only way we can be sure of our assessment of chemical safety in Tarkov.

5a68665c86f774255929b4c7.description: While you were searching the room, have you found anything unusual? Two bodies? Such an atrocity... It can't be just a coincidence. No wonder, though, the documents that you've managed to find are dedicated to some serious research in the field of Immunology, and from what we can understand, they have made some significant progress in that direction. Judging by the signature on the documents, the research was supervised by the head of the Medical Service of the health resort. Quite an elderly person, I've met him a couple of times on Health Care Worker Day. Although he was a venerable scholar he preferred the repose of the countryside over the bustle of laboratories and often spent time in the Woods, driving around in a white minivan. Witnessing the success, I believe, could have motivated him to start experimenting on humans, the first one most likely being himself, according to medical tradition. Scientists are always like that. Find his vehicle, and, if you also happen to find his blood samples, that would be great.

59675d6c86f7740a842fc482.description: Hey there, warrior. Still fighting? Good. There is this job, a cakewalk, really. Obviously, not of your caliber, it's gonna be a favor, so to say. I've received an order, they need some 60-rounders for 5.45 AKs. I know there definitely were some in bunkers near the sawmill, my guys stashed some goods there before. But they got driven out of there by those TerraGroup people, who then locked the bunkers with a key of some sort. Well, if you're going for the bunker, you'll need that key, I think it's hidden somewhere in dorms on Customs, people have seen some TerraGroup brass there a couple of times. Anyway, I don't care where you find them, but I need you to get them fresh and untouched by some traders. And hurry up, the order is urgent.

5c0d190cd09282029f5390d8.description: Greetings, warrior. How's life on the front lines? I've heard plenty about your skill with firearms, and I've tested you myself more than once. But when it comes to grenades, that's a different story. You need intuition, and you need brains, unless you want to catch your own shrapnel by accident. So show me what you can do with grenades and underbarrel launchers. Go make some noise in Tarkov.

64f5aac4b63b74469b6c14c2.description: Greetings, soldier! I've got an urgent job for you. Back before all this, I had an old friend, name was Oleg. We lost touch somewhere along the way, though I know he stayed in Tarkov. Then the other night... I had a bad feeling. Call it a dream, call it a gut instinct. I need you to look for him downtown. Check his apartment and the place where he worked. I can't remember the exact addresses anymore, but you should be able to figure it out. Just look for anything with a Soviet touch. Oleg was a true patriot.

5b4795fb86f7745876267770.description: Come on in if you're serious, got a new task for you! Those cameras you planted actually bore some fruit. Managed to find the right men, on good terms with Scavs. In short, I want to chum them up a bit, for the sake of peace. Because nowadays they are just too fucking mental. Wasting anyone indiscriminately, scared all my customers away, those motherfuckers. The trick is, these thieving bitches are from different gangs, and all need a different approach. So far we've settled on three gold chains for each, to get the conversation going, and we'll see where it goes... I don't have enough chains for all of them, but you're a smooth operator, you'll get them in no time. I'll point you where to stash them. Also, you should make sure the Interchange is clear of PMCs at the specific time, because otherwise, the right people may not reach the stash.

64f5e20652fc01298e2c61e3.description: Right, we'll put you to work then, since you're just hanging around here doing nothing. We've got this lad in our crew who's an absolute wizard with a spoon, his cooking is bloody incredible! I want to get him a little gift, show him some appreciation for looking after the lads. There's a fancy restaurant on Klimov Street downtown, supposedly the best chefs around and all that. Head over there, have a look around, see what you can find. Maybe you'll come across some secret recipe or something.

669fa395c4c5c04798002497.description: Hey, so I've noticed that more and more people are sneaking around at the chemical plant, it's getting a little crowded for my taste... That's why I need you to scout out a new exit route in case shit goes down, you know. If you do that, you can count on a magnificent reward, trust!

596a204686f774576d4c95de.description: Hello. Good that you are here. I have a job just for you since you are already familiar with it. Our engineers have successfully neutralized the chemical leak from the factory, but the water is still not fully purified. Although the only remaining pollutants are specific to petroleum products. We assume that this is connected to the TPP fuel oil storage next to the factory. Know these? It's hard to miss, there's a big pipe there. Technical rooms of fuel oil storage and furnace facility must be nominally equipped with the same radio- and gas analyzers you found in the factory, if, of course, they weren't stolen yet. Locate and bring them in, and we will solve the water problem in the region, at least for a while.

5a03153686f77442d90e2171.description: Hello. Things have been going very well between us. That is why I would like to involve you in one... complicated task. My men attempted to pass through the Factory, but they were not allowed through. They all died. Now I must fill out a great deal of paperwork and request reinforcements... And we must also punish those responsible. I do not know exactly who was responsible for the deaths of my men, so engage everyone you encounter. And make your shots count, headshots only. I want the enemy to understand that this was not a coincidence.

5a27b75b86f7742e97191958.description: Good day, mercenary. My name is Peacekeeper, and I was referred to you by Skier. Let us not waste time and get straight to business. I need to deliver certain equipment to certain people. I am going to provide you with everything required. Your task is to leave the goods in a designated location. On the coast, next to one of the... what is the Russian word?.. Ah! Breakwaters. There is a boat there. Leave everything inside.

5a27b9de86f77464e5044585.description: You know, I don't work only with you. I have one very useful and resourceful informant, but he has not checked in for quite some time. The last information I received from him mentioned a strange glow and mysterious voices near the old village. He said he would investigate what was happening, and then disappeared. Find him, or at least find out what may have happened to him.

5a27bb8386f7741c770d2d0a.description: Hello, good to see you! It is good to see you are still alive, haha. As you can see, my men and I have established the strongest presence on the coast. This is also where we communicate with our partners and buyers. We have managed to use the local meteorological equipment to transmit signals. However, scavengers, and not only them, keep trying to damage or destroy our antennas. We regularly deal with communication issues, and we even had to install surveillance cameras. But, as we know, vandals only understand force. Make it clear that the weather station and the entire shore are not places where people can damage our property without consequences. Show them exactly who they are interfering with. Use Blue Helmet equipment.

5a27bbf886f774333a418eeb.description: It's good to see you, mercenary. Those very cameras that we’ve installed on the weather station filmed a lot of interesting things. For instance, among other things, they spotted a new group of Scavs. They looked like sailors or fishermen, dressed in tatters and waders mostly. Lately, however, they have stopped appearing. I am very interested in their activities as their turnaround seems rather impressive. Search the Shoreline for a place where they could possibly live and mark it with a beacon for my people.

597a0e5786f77426d66c0636.description: That envelope from the dorm contained some chemical formula. And the flash drive described the reaction process. We found a guy here who’s good with the subject. So he said that they cooked up something like this at Polikhim, experimenting with some blue liquid shit, adding some other shit into it. Sorry, I wasn’t into chemistry at school! All these chemicals, valences, indecent bonds! Fuck that! Hehe. See, I even still remember some words. That was some teaching in schools back then! But whatever. It is necessary to confirm the experiment described there. And then this matter will shine upon us with new colors. This blue shit is abundantly scattered in barrels throughout the region, but nobody knows what it is. And nobody is too eager to figure that out either. But we will take our chance and find out. And make some profits with it. But this requires another stuff, It should be somewhere in the factory. There was a room filled with garbage - they had a laboratory there. Look for a bright yellow sort of syringe, looks like a pen, like a morphine syringe. Well, you get the idea.

5a27d2af86f7744e1115b323.description: Well, since we’re now best pals forever and shit, I think it makes sense to let you in on a real business that real folks are running. There are orders from a certain dude. Peacekeeper is the name - I think you know who he is. Man himself is from the UN force, which is here to prevent violence, supposedly. Can’t help laughing, ha-ha! I roll with him from the very beginning of all this fuck-up here. Working here, peddling stuff, stirring shit up, and occasionally dropping a body or two. So to the point, he’s snowed under with work and needs a tough reliable guy, just like you. Obviously, I have my cut. And, as it is easy for you to guess, the opportunity to work directly with an imported kingpin is not free. Yeah, yeah, off with that sour snot. Roll a several thousand bucks my way, and you’ll be doing business with all the benefits of Western civilization.

5bc479e586f7747f376c7da3.description: My friend, Shabelsky was his last name, used to write stories about the war. Even I had a fun time reading them sometimes. So recently he sold the rights to the entire series of books, and they made a movie after them in the West. But now he wants more money from the movie company, he hit the hard times, apparently. Even messaged me to look up some decent fighters here in Tarkov. It seems the whole world has forgotten about our city... They only remember us when they need a hired gun, and while things are going good they prefer to not notice our situation at all. Anyway, I digress. Are you ready for the second task from Sniper? You have to shoot at heads and legs from the same distance, 40 meters.

5d25b6be86f77444001e1b89.description: Hello there! You came right in time, I'm just packing up to go hunting. Do me a favor, not for service, but as a sign of friendship. Arrange a couple of rest spots for my way back: the trip is long, so I'll have to stop for a breather somewhere. The places should be safe, leave a Russian MRE and a bottle of water for each, agreed? At the same time, remember how to survive if you get caught with your pants down. I've got some stashes hidden here and there, for example, but you don't need to know about them yet.

639136e84ed9512be67647db.description: I'm stumped today, warrior. There are good people who need to escape the city. The closest they can get is through Avenue of Death, but there are snipers overlooking the whole area. One kid told me that if you shoot a signal flare there, the snipers should let you pass through, in that particular spot. But who knows if the kid was lying? Maybe he's trying to lead us to death. How do we find out if it's true that the snipers will stop firing after the signal... I got a couple flares lying around, why don't you go check it out, eh?

665eeacf5d86b6c8aa03c79b.description: We need to talk. Sanitar's goons have been prowling the shore area at nights. Obviously looking for something. Can't let it go unchecked. Scare them off while I try to find out what they're up to.

669fa3a08b4a64b332041ff7.description: Hello, soldier. Everyone seems to be flocking to Polikhim, running around looking for secrets... I found out something interesting, too. It turns out that the TerraGroup fucks had their own warehouse in the basement for extra important cargo, and there's a vial of some rare nasty stuff in there. You know what's gonna happen when people find out about this. One will ask to retrieve it, another will try to intercept it. Now imagine it falls into the wrong hands. It's best if you and I take this stuff before anyone else and keep it under wraps. The job's important. Will you help me?

66b38e144f2ab7cc530c3fe7.description: Come on in. So, how's your tripwire business going? No luck? Figures. This isn't like mindlessly shooting everyone. You've got to have a sense of intuition and know where the prey's gonna be. If you were a hunter, you'd understand. Try watching where the bandits hang out. Think about where your wire would catch the bastard off guard and how to conceal it. Take your time, use your best judgment. Only then will your hunt be fruitful. Come back when you find at least a couple good spots. I wouldn't be so quick to set these tripwires around, otherwise you'll kill some of your teammates by accident.

597a0f5686f774273b74f676.description: Here’s the thing. This whole chemical stuff worked like a charm, and it immediately became clear who do we push it to. And the receiving party is ready. Only one issue left to resolve. Find more of these yellow chemicals. The crux of the issue was partly resolved before us - someone has already tried. Don't know, intentionally or not, but if you believe the consignment notes from the same docs, the whole box of that stuff was already tried to be taken out from the factory. But this cargo was not logged on any of the checkpoints, so I figure it’s worth looking for somewhere in the warehouses on Customs. If they tried to transport it, then it's most likely still in the car, probably a van. And not just one lousy syringe, but a whole crate. Look out for some markings maybe, the crate has them. Got it? Ah, one more thing. My sweet friends Prapor and Therapist popped up, poking around. So come on, better not turncoat now. Just a bit more and we’ll be running this place. Good luck, bruv. I'll tell about you to Ragman - he'll get some good helmets for you to buy.

597a160786f77477531d39d2.description: Young man, I cannot stand aside on this one. I'm aware that you are now working with this so-called Skier. This disreputable man pursues completely lucrative interests and that is a matter of great concern to me. Especially all this story with secret experiments on a substance that you call the yellow chemical. The substance is extremely dangerous, and I have a major request for you, could you give up the coordinates of the chemicals to me? Yes, I'm aware of all the details of your adventures with the Skier. I would come up with good payment for that. Again, this is all just for the sake of our people.

597a171586f77405ba6887d3.description: Good afternoon! Our world is really small here - I found out that you’ve been teaming up with Skier lately. Let’s go straight to business - I need to know where to get that chemical of yours, a big customer wants to buy out all the crates for a good price. I don’t care why he needs it, I’m a bit tighter on funds now than I would like to be. So, are you in? I won't disappoint with the reward, of course.

59c93e8e86f7742a406989c4.description: Well hello-hello, little rat. That last trick you pulled was total bullshit, that's for sure. I even thought of getting a team to get rid of you, mister fancypants. Well, since you're here, I guess you want to amend for your sins. It's simple to me, like taking candy from a baby - my trust can be bought. One million in rubles - and we'll forget about past misunderstandings.

5bc47dbf86f7741ee74e93b9.description: I see you're quite a good shot, kid. Sniper said he wants to test your reaction time. The faster one wins, as he says. As in that film, remember, "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly", only with a bolt-action rifle instead of a revolver. Life here certainly isn’t a movie, but the reaction and the choice of position are very important in the firefight, especially in urban conditions. If you survive this, help yourself to my cowboy hat, I have one around here somewhere. You choose yourself, who you want to be: the good, the bad, or the ugly.

5d25aed386f77442734d25d2.description: Hello there, come in, take a seat. The path of ours is not easy, not easy at all. Fighting scum is dangerous and requires extraordinary skills. For example, being fast, quiet, agile and deadly. Flanking the enemy, outplaying them on their own field. Your buddies chained in their body armor will never be able to master these skills. Therefore, before embarking on serious tasks, hone this skill.

5d25bfd086f77442734d3007.description: Hello there, warrior! My hunt went as planned. You know, the water you prepared for me did really come in handy. By the way, how good are you at handling dehydration? Show me how long PMCs can stay without water.

5d25c81b86f77443e625dd71.description: Hello there. Has it ever happened to you that you got into trouble, but there is no time to take care of the wound as you have to save your skin? Self-control in the most difficult situations is the key to survival. This is a very important skill in these difficult days for our city. Show me how well you handle pain.

5d25cf2686f77443e75488d4.description: You know, in combat - as in hunting, there are only two behavior models. You are either a hunter or prey. And since you intend to become a real hunter, you must learn to track prey without exposing yourself.

665eec1f5e47a79f8605565a.description: The Thirsty dude? You too?! Why are you all bringing him up all of a sudden? Yeah, I worked with this guy. Сouldn't last five minutes without a drink. We made some good money with him back then. Always brought good loot, that guy. My respect to him. But he's been out of the game for a long time, at least in Tarkov. I can give you a tip on where he dumped his extra supplies, but not for free. I'm looking for two tanks of propane right now. Why don't you find it for me, and then we'll talk about your guy?

665eec4a4dfc83b0ed0a9dca.description: So, I keep my word. Before you, Sanitar was sniffing around that guy, too. But his business proposition was shite, so I didn't tell him anything. I'll tell you, but a bit later. Here are some nice propane tanks for you. Yeah, the ones you brought. Now you have to stash them. One in the nature reserve, in the Scav bunker with the radio tower. The other at the Customs area, in the little store by the crossroads. Just make sure to not shoot the tanks, okay? If you finish the job, you'll get more info.

665eeca45d86b6c8aa03c79d.description: Thank you for reaching out. I know you're investigating a certain person called Thirsty. Sanitar is investigating him as well, for a specific reason. He's always hunting for any information on TerraGroup's activities. Surely it's all connected. If you can intercept the data first, bring it to me, I'll pay you handsomely. Besides, in my hands, it won't cause another disaster.

665eeca92f7aedcc900b0437.description: Hello again. I was able to extract some scraps of information about a certain drug from the diary you brought. The owner of the diary used it frequently. It's some sort of combat stimulant, I think you might be interested in it. I can provide you with samples if you help me reproduce and test it. Here's a list of the items you'll need.

6834145ebc1f443d7603c8a7.description: Sup mate. Got a job for ya. An old pal of mine is looking for the right people for his business. I don't know the ins and outs, just the first stage of recruitment, so to speak. I see you're interested. You heard anything about the Arena yet? You gotta put up flyers around Tarkov. Like "come and check it out", shit like that, you know. Hey, serious people always start small! I've got a couple of posters ready for ya, but if you lose them, it's your own bloody problem, got it? Bring them to the Scav stronghold at the customs terminal. Off you go then.

6834158f2f0e2a7eb90b62c8.description: Hello, champion! A friend of mine gave you a little tryout assignment. Now I've decided to meet you in person. People call me Ref. Hosting the Arena and the big bucks, ha! Clearly you don't mind making money, and I'm in desperate need of new staff. Business is booming, and I'm short-handed. We're expanding! We got another fight planned soon. As they used to say in ancient Rome, "the people demand bread and circuses." The latter is fine, but the bread is running late. A little supply disruption, don't worry about it. Just get me some food and booze for the audience.

68341846186efa3c5b07f989.description: You did a great job on my assignments. I also ran you through my databases... Just a precaution. You don't hire just anybody, you know what I mean, brother? I'm promoting you to a tester! You're gonna be testing equipment for the Arena. I've just received a good batch of bullpups for a delicious price. Go ahead and try them out on some hobos. After that, I'll decide if these rifles will go to my cleanup guys or the gladiators.

68341a0b2f0e2a7eb90b62d4.description: Right, now it's time to test some body armor. This is for the cleanup crew only. Let's see how it holds up against real mercs. Try killing a few PMCs while wearing this PACA armor. After that, I'll see what else I can come up with.

68341b407559f4e6d50bc0ce.description: I came up with a great idea to make the Arena even better. And I need your help. I need to find some armor plates for a guy. He's a frequent performer, so it's time to give him an upgrade to get the crowd excited. That's the thing about shows, you don't add wood in time, the fire goes out. Well, now go get me some armor plates. The crowd's gonna squeal when they see him!

68341c4babec72d95d0c1260.description: Look, you're starting to feel like family to me. Like a brother! I think I can hook you up with some serious work. I've got some co-founders in the Arena, Kaban and Kollontay, maybe you know them. Thought they were cool guys, but now they decided to play politics. They want to put their champion in the Arena, can you imagine? And a good champion brings in so much money, you'd know. It's gonna take a lot of time and money to rebuild the business. We need to put a scare into these guys so they realize they're crossing the line. Take some explosive bricks and plant them inside the cafe in the city center. Without detonators. We're not gonna blow anything up, but just make it look like a big deal. Let them run around with their asses on fire.

68341d7d7559f4e6d50bc0db.description: Kaban and Kollontay shit themselves alright, but that wasn't good enough for me. I'd like to finish them off. You don't have to help me with that, of course, but... I already have a plan. You need to go down to their places and shoot their bodyguards or whatever they're called. Everyone in there is a trusted person for those two, so they're the perfect targets. BUT! Make sure Kaban and Kollontay themselves are unharmed!

68341eb25619c8e2a9031501.description: Well-well, you've finished your first assessment. I think it's right about time for a new champion of the Arena to rise. And it's going to be you. By consent, of course. We don't practice cruelty here, haha! I can help you reach heights and riches beyond your wildest dreams. You just have to take me up on my offer. But, you know, actions always trump words. So go ahead, enter the Arena and win. That's how I will know you're ready to push forward.

68341f6fe2e7ef70a3060a0a.description: You're under my wing from now on, brother. I'll make sure you get progress good, but you're gonna have to get your ass in gear more often. Let's start with the basics. The Arena's in Tarkov, but the biggest sponsors are overseas. They watch every game, place bets, throw money at the favorites. And you need to get some of those big shots interested. Get their attention, show them you're worthy. Make a name for yourself. One win alone isn't enough to do it. Show them you can make a thrilling performance!

6834202a186efa3c5b07f9a2.description: You're doing great! But it's too early to stop. Shine your face more often, impress the audience. Stand out. Become the one they talk about, the one they come to see. Then the cash will come, and then other goodies: cars, girls... Although Tarkov is a little short on the latter. Anyway, the Arena is a great career opportunity right now, ha!

683421515619c8e2a9031511.description: How's the mood? Battle-ready? Ready to shine in the Arena once more? Ready to shred some motherfuckers? The crowd is betting on you, so don't let the audience down! Speaking of that. You got some money? You gotta bet on yourself and then win a few times. You'll make tons of cash, and you'll be famous. Bring the money, I'll organize everything. Just be warned: if keep losing too often, you start again.

68342265a8d674b5740b31f0.description: I have good news! Excellent news, in fact! I hope you've already picked out a little apartment in Tarkov's elite neighborhood, because you'll have it soon with all this money! Kidding. All the houses in those neighborhoods are soon gonna collapse anyway. Anyway, some very powerful people from across the border are interested in you. Powerful and wealthy. I can't tell you their names, it's a business secret, and I'm not violating what I signed. So, these people are ready to take you under their wing and sponsor you heavily, but first they want guarantees. You need to become the champion. Fly high, soar above the rest. You're gonna have to spend more time in the Arena. I can see it in your eyes that you're ready.

68342446a8d674b5740b31fc.description: So you're saying you were in the last champion's apartment? All right then. I'll pretend like it never happened. Just remember, curiosity killed the cat. And the last champion, too. He was a good guy, I liked him, but he got soft, lost his touch. You should be practicing more, not wandering around the city. Otherwise, your ranking will start to drop.

6834254f2f0e2a7eb90b62ef.description: I've been hearing rumors... Very unpleasant rumors. They say you're trying to dig my business up. Look, we've known each other for a while. You're like a brother to me! Don't do something you'll regret later. The less you know, the better you sleep, you hear that? Until I'm absolutely confident in you, I'm gonna have my men watching you. I don't want you pulling any stunts, champ. And if you find anything during your little date with the old champion, bring it to me. Then we can forget about this happy little accident.

683425dd8f5b18d29a05d9d1.description: So you saw a dead body. Did you search it? Did you check around it? I'm just pointing out that you're blind. The champion, as far as I know, kept a journal. Yeah, like some teenager, but that's actually working in your favor. Why don't you go over there again and take a closer look? There's got to be more information in the journal about Ref, some dirt on him. Do that if you want to stop being expendable in the Arena. And one more thing: if you bring me any info on Ref that'll be worthy of my time, I'll pay you well.

6834233fecd5cf3a440d855b.description: Hello. I hear you're working for Ref now. I've been keeping tabs on you for a while. I used to know a man who got tangled up just like you. He was Ref's previous champion for a while and then all of a sudden he disappeared. And I know for sure this had nothing to do with Kaban and Kollontay. If you don't want to vanish the same way this guy did, look for the last champion's apartment. I believe there's something of interest left there. The champion used to hang out with the smugglers in Dorms on Customs. Maybe you'll find some clues on how to get into the apartment.

5a27ba9586f7741b543d8e85.description: Our partnership has been quite fruitful lately, it's great -- and I want to trust you more. After all, reliable people are valuable. It's time I let you in on a delicate operation I'm running at the resort. However, first, I would like you to prove your loyalty to me, bring me an ear necklace. Haha! Just kidding about the ears, but seriously. If you want in on this operation you'll need to prove your loyalty to me, but not necessarily with blood, if you know what I mean.

5ac3460c86f7742880308185.description: I think you’ve already guessed that I’m building a bitcoin farm. Thanks to the satellite "Ebambium", it’s not all surfing and memes. The more time you spend online, the more you realize the new age is upon us. Change in data distribution speed changed everything. The world has entered a new industrial revolution, though it has moved on from the real world into the virtual one. We create whole worlds, with their own economies and laws. And, looking at what is happening around us I'm almost sure the digital world is more honest and better than real. Much more depends on yourself here. It doesn’t matter just as much where you were born and who your parents were. Okay, I’m almost done with the power supply. Just need a few more details. Bring over some cables, tee-connectors, and line peripherals.

5ac346a886f7744e1b083d67.description: Hello. You know, a few days ago I caught myself thinking that Tarkov had somehow become... quieter. At least for me. Then yesterday I realized that feeling was misleading. Someone's been deliberately jamming signals in my area of operation. I don't like it, but I don't want to scare them off just yet. You understand why, they could always come back with something more sophisticated. So first I'm going to try a little trick to work around the jammers without alerting whoever's behind them. To do that, I'll need a few components... Here's the list.

5ac3479086f7742880308199.description: I don't like to pretend, although we all do. Sometimes in order to survive, and sometimes because we’re just afraid. You know, I'm not exactly much of a talker, especially with strangers, but you seem like a nice guy. If you managed to earn my trust, I think you'll come to terms with just about anyone. After all, only personal relationships will help us survive now. Speaking with Pavel Yegorovich, if he trusts you, perhaps I will be able to set up the supply of gunpowder.

626bd75e47ea7f506e5493c5.description: Hello, friend. I've been thinking about something. It's starting to seem to me that I don't really understand anything in life. Come, sit down... People are saying there's a live broadcast going somewhere in the city. They say that someone is performing surgeries and filming it on their camera. I'd understand if it was an actually good willed doctor helping people. I would even understand if there was an organ trade, although that in itself is disgusting. But tell me, why stream this? Is this a kink for some perverted oligarchs? I honestly don't have an answer. But I do know that this broadcast must be shut down. Can you put a jammer near them?

638fcd23dc65553116701d33.description: You know, you look like someone who'd help clean out a bank! Why are you so uptight, bro, that's not what I'm talking about, I'm an honest businessman! But sometimes you watch a heist movie and get so many ideas in your head... Anyway, to the point. I have information that a man from a financial institution that controls the banking sector of Tarkov kept a journal, you know, for when everything goes to shit... The data he kept was from classified official reports. So anyway, as you know, everything did go to shit, but he couldn't manage to pass the info on. Do you have any idea what kind of juice there might be in his doodles? Search the place, find me that journal.

639136fa9444fb141f4e6eee.description: Friend, there is another task, an unusual one. One of my clients was living in the area of the hotel when the events began. And he had reason to believe he was being watched. He saw a couple of leaked photos from the hotel courtyard. We need to find the room where the rat is sitting. Most likely, you'll find something if you look for tech: cameras, bugs... Anything you find, give it to me. It'll come in handy.

65734c186dc1e402c80dc19e.description: Hey, brother! What's up, how you doing? Good? Well I unfortunately have some guys messing with me. They've got a gang, they think they're the hippest guys in the neighborhood, and they're interfering with my business as well! We gotta show them where they belong. And it ain't in that fancy barbershop they're holed up in, that's for sure. No, no need to kick anyone out. We're gonna be subtle. Pretend to be one of them and shoot pretty much anyone you see. I need everyone in the city to start hating them. When you're done, drop the outfit off at their barbershop so people know who's the maniac shooting everything. Can you do that?

65802b627b44fa5e14638899.description: Hello, brother. Kinda in a bad mood today, not gonna lie. I feel like I've been ripped off! I bought an apparently running SUV for 2,000 bucks. And everything seemed fine, they brought it to Shoreline, but the driver never contacted me back after that. It's not a lot of money, but still sucks. Can you go see if the car's actually there?

666314b4d7f171c4c20226c3.description: Hello again! Remember the good old time when all the major fighting took place at Polikhim? People were buying tons of gear from me back then. There was a kit, the most popular among PMCs. I was wondering how it performs in the field nowadays. Check it out for me and tell me how it is, yea?

669fa39b91b0a8c9680fc467.description: Hello, mercenary. I've been asking myself the same question all day: why does no one notice the obvious patterns in platinum price fluctuations? A crisis is coming, and they keep calling me a pessimist... That's alright. We'll see how much they're willing to pay for platinum once the prices go through the roof. I need to prepare. There are old heat exchangers scattered across Tarkov, and they still contain Soviet-era corrugated tubing with platinum inserts. Would you help me replenish my reserves? Just mark the heat exchangers with strobes, and I'll pay you well.

675c085d59b0575973005f52.description: Yo, you doing good? You will never believe what I'm going to tell you right now. I have a job for you! Alright, jokes aside, the Reshala guy wants to jump head first into a new business. And believe me, I don't want this fucker in there. I found out this punk's planning a meeting with one of my partners with ties to the big land. Thing is, we only know the meeting spot, but we don't know when they're gonna sort their shit out. So I hired a trustworthy sniper to crash the meeting when it happens. Except that now he's in his position out there all the fucking time, can't even go down to take a piss. What's more, the stash I set up for him at the lookout spot was found by the Scavs, and they looted everything clean. You think you can drop off the rest of the gear? It's at the plant with three large pipes in the middle of the industrial zone. It's got some metal scaffolding or something around it... Hide it all over that scaffolding, alright? Shit, man, of fucking course I'll pay you for it. Work hard, and you'll earn hard, hehe.

5a03173786f77451cb427172.description: Good day, my friend. While you were bringing justice, you surely noticed the helicopter standing at the health resort pad. We need to hurry and pick up everything of value that is left in it. For now, it's wide open and dangerous in there. Your task is to mark the helicopter with a beacon and, most importantly, find the safe path to access it with a vehicle, preferably through the woods. Mark it, I mean the path, with a beacon as well. After that, it’s Blue Helmets’ job.

63913715f8e5dd32bf4e3aaa.description: Friend, remember when you and I shut down that broadcast with the jammer at the Lighthouse? These people started it up again. The guys showed me the tape, it's just... I'm speechless. I regret watching it. Can you find a new location where the broadcast is coming from? From the surroundings, it looks like some kind of grocery store.

666314b0acf8442f8b0531a1.description: What's up, warrior. I've been talking to my nephew about some video game where you shoot demons. I thought I'd give him a little present. Anyway, here's the task: get me a double-barrelled shotgun like in that game, and make it look real nasty! Oh, and make the barrel shorter.

666314b2a9290f9e0806cca3.description: Warrior! Remember the DB you were building? I couldn't deliver it past the border. That's a bummer, the shotty is gorgeous. Speaking of, we've got plenty of demons of our own in Tarkov. Can't even take a shit in the woods at night! Why don't you take this gun out for a spin and deal with those devils?

666314b696a9349baa021bac.description: Good afternoon. I've learned that comrade Prapor has become nostalgic lately. Although I can't find time for such things myself, your and Prapor's affairs have brought me to a good idea. When the locals found out about TerraGroup's underground laboratory, there was quite a stir! It was a breakthrough for my business, the lab is where I got my unique equipment from. Well, there may still be some original American leftover LEDX from back then. Can you get me one of those? It would really help our cause.

666314b8312343839d032d24.description: Hello, friend! You know how even small changes affect our isolated Tarkov world. Take, for example, the arrival of the humanitarian aid that's being dropped from airplanes. Even I couldn't get some of the components for my work before. But now you can find real treasures in these crates! By the way, I'd like to arrange for a new package. To do this, I need to make sure that the pilots work as instructed, give a drop right after the launch of the red flare. Can you help me with that?

666314bafd5ca9577902e03a.description: The factory run was amazing, your stories made my memory come flooding back! The gunfights are one thing, but when the bandits' leaders showed up, that's when it got real hot. Reshala was the first to show up, always bragging about his gold TT. Back then, everyone wanted one of these in their holster. But now, for some reason, the demand for TTs is going down. Can you remind everyone what kind of weapons real men fight with?

666314bc1d3ec95634095e77.description: Sup, bandit! How's life? A little birdie told me there's a special magazine in the Ultra mall at the Interchange. They wrote about our Russian video game, which is recognized all over the world! I guess the guys really came up with a great concept!

666314bd920800278d0f6748.description: Hello, soldier. I've met some rookies recently, here in Tarkov. They say people don't watch everything on tape anymore, they watch it live! Programs, stories, and some even show their everyday life non-stop. They even said a bunch of civilians are watching Tarkov's activities live! It seems that the whole world is interested in our city! I don't understand how they organized the broadcast to the outside world, but I wouldn't mind a second pair of eyes. It's a simple task - organize surveillance in some spots, and I'll return the favor.

666314bf1cd52e3d040a2e78.description: Hey! Remember the client with the game magazine? I have a new order. I need a data disk, it's all related to the same game. Some scam artist said that the people who created the game had stolen user data from 2 million accounts! And as proof he showed a hard drive to everyone, allegedly with this leak. But the publishers are serious guys, they would not allow such bullshit. So the client is looking for the drive to clarify the situation. My guys said the drive should be in an old wooden house near the health resort, there is a toilet on the left and a rag above the entrance.

666314c10aa5c7436c00908c.description: Hello there. I know some people, a documentary crew. They want to make a movie about Tarkov. They're risk-takers, but I can't change their minds. So I figured I'd better help them get it done quickly and stay alive. Equipment for them was also dropped from the airplane you called in, but the hardware is fragile and was partially damaged during the landing. Can you help me find replacement parts?

666314c3acf8442f8b0531a3.description: You're a good guy, I'll tell you that. I wouldn't trust another man to do this, but you're an experienced fellow, you understand what I'm saying. I heard that Prapor is now into modern technology, and he's got cameras everywhere, watching everything from his man cave. And recently he ruined one of my deals, started yelling like a damn rooster, something about the rules of trade and military order... We have to show him what a motherfucker he's become. Oops, sorry for the offensive language. Hope it doesn't disrespect your community guidelines.

666314c5a9290f9e0806cca5.description: How's it going, brother? I heard the city's stirring up, collecting souvenirs, reminiscing over old times. And I just got a lead on something like this. They keep these things in museums. In the old days, each city had its own key, which the governor received at the time of establishment. I even saw one on a tour when I was a kid! They don't do that anymore, but Tarkov does have its own key, apparently! When the city was laid out, they made one for historical reference. And I know where to find it! If you bring it back, we'll make a fortune.

5ae448a386f7744d3730fff0.description: Good day to you, merc! Wanna become a respected member of Tarkov's fine society? Then you'll have to do some business with me, Wanna do some trading, perhaps? Or you can help me out with a few little tasks. There's always work to be found. Well, I'll do my best to find some for you, at least.

63ab180c87413d64ae0ac20a.description: Young man, hello! How is your health? Nothing bothering you? The thing is, one of my messengers who transports the poor stranded people in the city is worried about the lack of an escort on the next route. Could you meet with him and go for a ride with him? I promise you won't be shortchanged! He'll be waiting for you on Primorsky Avenue, in a black SUV.

5ac346cf86f7741d63233a02.description: I've recently tried to build a neural network to control the cameras. Teaching it to differentiate between faces and look for matches in the database didn't take much time. Then I wondered, what if we ever create a mind, which will realize itself, what it will be like? In the last many years of civilization, humans kept becoming more humane. They started treating each other better, started caring for nature, animals. An opinion was formed that principles of human duty go side by side with highly developed civilization and reason. Then, shall it turn out that the mind of the computer, which of course will very quickly evolve into an over-mind due to its high learning capabilities, will also be most humane at the same time? Interesting, right? But we need to deal with these pests already. Install suppressors on the antennas you found, and, just in case, another one on the tower, also there on the Shoreline.

5ac346e886f7741d6118b99b.description: I've been thinking about that thing we discussed last time. Have people really become kinder with the development of civilization? Do they really go hand in hand? All this time, where we believe there is civilization, life has become more comfortable, easier. There were increasingly fewer worries about safety or getting something to eat. It's easy to be humane when nothing is threatening you. The answer to these questions was right before my eyes. The situation in Tarkov has shown us how much kinder we have become. Once the issues of survival came to the front, it turned out that decent people aren’t more common than maybe 500 years ago. There're probably even less of them now. What do you think, are you one of them? Okay, don’t overthink it. I need you to do something for me. However, you will need to remember quite a lot for this job. Practice in memorizing large volumes of information, I’ll contact you later.

5d25e4b786f77408251c4bfc.description: Well hello there, warrior! How are you? Doing good? Listen, I've got an unusual task to do, Mechanic asked me to make one special thing for his home, and this \"thing\" is such a complicated one that it requires some advanced electronics. And there's no place in the city where these things could be found, damn it. However, there are rumors that somewhere around here is the TerraGroup laboratory. It might have the details we need. The Laboratory is too dangerous to send you there alone, but at least bring me the access cards. Will you help? And yes, the cards should be new, not the ones you could just buy from those shady traders.

5d25e4d586f77443e625e388.description: Look who we've got here! Hello there! Listen, you know about the military base close to the health resort? Probably were there yourself. So, I've got some news. They say the old warehouses there still have a lot of food left in them, and that bandit groups began roaming there, not your regular Scavs, they are well-equipped. I want you to check out if there's anything left in those warehouses. But be careful, there really are a lot of dangerous people there.

639135b04ed9512be67647d7.description: Hello, warrior. I have another personal matter. I have a friend in town, Oleg. He's a retired captain, such a great man! A real fighter, you and I would never reach his greatness. And what a patriot! The problem is that I haven't heard from him for a while now. I'm worried about him. Will you check on him?

639136df4b15ca31f76bc31f.description: In our line of work, we can't afford to rest or slow down. Evil won't be defeated that way. So here's my next task for you. I've been told that something suspicious is happening at the Reserve base, around the loading area. Head there and deal with whatever filth has gathered there. And don't forget to fire the signal flare first, so I know you've begun your work. I'll take care of anyone who tries to run.

5bc480a686f7741af0342e29.description: It's good that you're alive, tasks from Sniper are not easy. Let's wait for a little before the next test. There is going to be a lot more complicated sniper work from now on, so my advice is that you master your bolt-action rifle handling skills some more. Come back when you're ready.

5d25e2d886f77442734d335e.description: Come on in. As a hunter, I can tell you for sure that holding control over the target is really important. Sometimes if you manage to blind the animal, even the most dangerous one, it stops being dangerous to you. This works with humans as well. Who cares how pimped out their guns are if they're as blind as moles? I want you to show me if you're able to properly blind your enemy.

61904daa7d0d857927447b9c.description: Hello, soldier. You know, I've lost almost everyone close to me because of this carnage around. There's nobody to even talk to at dinner. There's you who comes by for an hour or two, but you go back to that war of yours, even if there's no point in fighting anymore. Eh, I won't burden you with my talks. I have a request for you. I had a good friend, we always were very close together - similar in character, understood each other perfectly. He's set up at the Cape Dalniy, in that old village, but far from the people - made a nice dugout for himself at the outskirts. I don't know if anyone still lives in that village, but I do want you to find my friend. I'll be waiting to hear from you, kid.

63a511ea30d85e10e375b045.description: Hello, Mechanic gave me the gist of the situation. It's horrible, gives me the creeps. But we have to get to the truth. And you know what's even worse? The camera that Mechanic's techs looked at contained not only the recordings we knew of, but also even more at different places. As if someone is playing with us and wants us to see these recordings. There was an old house, with corpses at the table, like in a biblical story. Find this place, something's not right about this.

5bc4826c86f774106d22d88b.description: As Sniper likes to say: "The best tool against a sniper is another sniper".
